input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4 already gives Customer a convenience exit from the Agreement or an individual Service Option Attachment on one month's notice at a calendar month end, which beats the 60–90 day fallback ceiling, and IBM has no mid-term convenience right: its only Agreement-level termination right is for material breach (3.3) and its only unilateral exit is term-end non-renewal on 90 days' notice (3.2). The fallback fails on a single material term — the early termination charges cross-referenced to Attachment A are open-ended — so our sole edit caps them at three months' recurring charges for terminated Services, stating the basis so the amount is not arguable at exit. We reverted the earlier cosmetic relocation of "for convenience"; §3.4 is otherwise untouched. The absence of a pro-rata refund of prepaid charges is a preferred-only gap, noted rather than redlined.

proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' recurring charges for terminated Services
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Attachment A early termination charges are open-ended, so we have capped them at three months' recurring charges for the terminated Services, consistent with our fallback position.
